reading_note: The teaching describes the internal anatomy of self-love as it stratifies itself into five discrete degrees. The arc moves from (1) the original eruption of five storehouses of evil from the natural mind devoid of light, (2) their elaboration into five archons/spirits/bodies/tastes/trees/creatures — five complete modes of selfhood, each producing its own kind of affection-creatures, (3) the supreme kingship of smoke (falsity from evil) ruling the whole, (4) the composite portrait of the King of Darkness — a Grand Man inverted: lion-face, eagle-shoulders, fish-tail (the inversion of celestial, spiritual, and natural goods into their opposites), (5) the inner vehicles of self-love (mire, bitterness, burning iron — increasingly intense states of corrupted affection) and the inner three (Enthymesis/the cupidity of Death and the matter that is its substrate), (6) the cognitive economy of evil — sense-perception-only knowing, blindness to interior states, communal devouring among archons, (7) the seizure-and-withdrawal rhythm by which self-love grasps and consumes, terrifying lower powers like thunder, and finally (8) the systematic correspondence-table of the five kingdoms: Smoke→gold/lead-fruit, Fire→lion/bronze/bitter, Wind→eagle/iron/sharp, Water→fish/silver/sweet, Darkness→dragon/lead/bitter-fruit. The whole shows how evil, having no being of its own, must counterfeit the five-fold structure of heavenly good in inverted form.
